title_prefix: tr() miniscript leaves are accepted and
mechanism: src/rpc/descriptors.lisp:884-886 routes a tr() leaf into %parse-miniscript-descriptor with :tapscript, so tr(K,<miniscript>) parses, passes %check-miniscript-sane and derives an address. The signer, tr-leaf-satisfaction (src/rpc/descriptors.lisp:1369-1425), is a hand-written CASE over out-desc-kind covering only :pk, :pkh, :multi-a and :sortedmulti-a; a leaf of kind :miniscript falls through the CASE and returns NIL, which %tr-script-path-witness (src/rpc/rawtransaction.lisp:352-406) reads as 'unsatisfiable'. Its docstring still says 'We have no tapscript miniscript', which stopped being true when the tapscript miniscript context was added. Core has no per-kind table at all: SignTaprootScript (refs/bitcoin/src/script/sign.cpp:528-540) satisfies EVERY tapscript leaf through miniscript::FromScript(script, TapSatisfier) followed by ms->Satisfy(), so pk/pkh/multi_a are just miniscript fragments and an arbitrary miniscript leaf signs by the same code path.
consequence: The wallet's own address generation hands out receive addresses for a tr() descriptor whose script path it can never spend, even holding every private key, and the wallet counts the coins as its own balance. Verified end to end: an active ranged tr(<internal>,and_v(v:pk(X/0/*),pk(Y/0/*))) imported into a private-key wallet answered getnewaddress with bcrt1pnvzp7h...; a non-ranged tr(<internal>,and_v(v:pk(WIF_B),pk(WIF_C))) was imported, deriveaddresses produced bcrt1p2r3p2c2..., the funding wallet's own sendtoaddress paid it, the receiving wallet reported getbalance 1.0, and signrawtransactionwithwallet returned complete:false with 'no satisfiable script path for P2TR'. Coins are recoverable only by moving the descriptor and keys to Bitcoin Core. Because the failure is reported as an unsigned input rather than an error, nothing warns the operator before the coins arrive. Severity raised from the finder's S2 to S1: this is exactly the rubric's 'spendable-looking address that is unspendable, with coins sent there by the wallet's own flow'.
evidence: Container: /Users/sen/common-lisp/bl-ga11v-miniscript-s2, warm image, probes under build/ga11probe/ (git-ignored). (1) p1.lisp -- through the shipped signer bl.rpc:sign-tx-inputs, driven by the existing tests/wallet/descriptor-tests.lisp:974 %tr-sign-and-verify harness whose tr-scripts construction mirrors src/wallet/wallet-spend.lisp:1829-1850 verbatim: tr(I,{pk(A),and_v(v:pk(B),pk(C))}) parsed with leaf kinds (:PK :MINISCRIPT); holding B and C the result was (:ERRS ("no satisfiable script path for P2TR") :WITNESS NIL :VERIFIED NIL); the multi_a(2,B,C) control in the identical tree with the identical two keys gave (:ERRS NIL :WITNESS ((64 64 70 65)) :VERIFIED T); the pk(A) leaf of the same tree holding A gave (:ERRS NIL :WITNESS ((64 34 65)) :VERIFIED T). (2) p1c.lisp -- full wallet flow on regtest through bl.rpc:dispatch-rpc-method: import T, deriveaddresses -> bcrt1p2r3p2c2rx7y72dfhx5fl90d49nnqfxxrt7gcg9mj93wjrzcn9gpsvxts9g, sendtoaddress from the funding wallet, ms-balance 1.0, signrawtransactionwithwallet -> complete:false, errors[0].error = 'no satisfiable script path for P2TR'; multi_a control in the same shape -> complete:true. (3) p1d.lisp -- active ranged import + getnewaddress 'bech32m' -> bcrt1pnvzp7hvl7jkewp6shzh2yuscxjuskv20l8rh0fcx59a04ce4jezsk5w4sx for the miniscript-leaf descriptor. Sources: src/rpc/descriptors.lisp:1369 (the CASE), :1377-1379 (the stale docstring), :884-886 (the routing); src/rpc/rawtransaction.lisp:380 (the only call site); refs/bitcoin/src/script/sign.cpp:528-540. Note: descriptorprocesspsbt cannot reach this at all -- %descriptor-sign-maps (src/wallet/psbt.lisp:1586-1607) returns no tr-scripts, so its %psbt-record-signatures call omits the argument; the reachable shipped paths are signrawtransactionwithwallet / walletprocesspsbt / the wallet spend path.
fix_shape: Delete the kind table and satisfy every tapscript leaf the way Core does: give tr-leaf-satisfaction the leaf SCRIPT (already computed by %tr-tree-parts), run bl.val:ms-from-script on it under *ms-context* :tapscript, and satisfy the resulting node with an ms-satisfier whose sign-fn is the existing x-only sigfn -- Core's SignTaprootScript in one function. That makes 8c3b8174 (ms-from-script has no tapscript arms: no 32-byte key push, no multi_a decode) and c9076fba (ms-produce-input has no :multi-a arm, a hard ECASE failure) blocking prerequisites rather than latent S3s, and it also needs Core's FromPKHBytes seam (see c7fe77bf) so a tapscript pkh() leaf resolves Hash160(XOnlyPubKey) back to a key through the signing provider. Keep the existing per-kind results as a regression oracle: the ported path must reproduce the same witness element orders the current pk/pkh/multi_a arms produce, including multi_a's reversed stack and pkh()'s key-above-signature order, both of which are already asserted by tests/wallet/descriptor-tests.lisp tr-script-path-spends-verify.
